caption: The drawing depicts a round plate with a subtle beige or light brown outline. On the upper left area of the plate, there is a floral decorative design featuring white flowers with yellow centers, accompanied by brown leaves and thin, curved stems. Small clusters of tiny brown or tan flowers are scattered around the primary floral motif, extending toward the edges of the plate. Beneath the main drawing of the plate, there is a smaller, plain outline of the plate's shape presented in a square box. There is also a circular official stamp on the left side of the drawing and handwriting, likely a signature, on the lower right that reads “Jos. Sudeck.” The drawing is on a cream or light tan background with a rectangular border framing the central composition.
title: Platter
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
